chunks: Al-Tawhid: My father, from Sa'd, from Ahmad and Abdallah, the two sons of Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Mahbub, from Ibn Riab, from Zurara, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'The fitra of Allah which He created the people upon.' He said: 'He created them all upon Tawhid.'

key_terms.عَلَيْهَا: Upon it (referring to the innate nature)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Fitrat Allah' in the Quran according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Zurara asks Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) about the meaning of the phrase 'fitrat Allah' in the Quran. The Imam explains that God created all human beings upon Tawhid (divine unity), indicating that the innate nature of humanity is monotheism. This narration is foundational in Shia theology for establishing 'fitrah' as an inherent, pre-existing knowledge of God rather than merely acquired belief, linking the cosmic order to human consciousness.

en.ammaar-muslim: 6. [6/383] al-Tawhid: My father from Sa’d from Ahmad and Abdallah the two sons of Muhammad b. Isa from Ibn Mahbub from Ibn Riab from Zurara who said:
I asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about the words of Allah Mighty and Majestic: “The Fitra of Allah which He created the people upon” [30:30]. He said: He created them all upon Tawhid.
